# Charles Shima

> Charles Shima is the Architect of the Travelpreneur™ Economy, founder of Tourifique and ZaNiheza, and an entrepreneur, innovator, AI evangelist and global speaker. His work explores travel innovation, creator monetization, entrepreneurship, emerging technologies and opportunities across Africa, Canada and the world. He is available worldwide for keynotes, panels and workshops in English and French. Website: https://shimacharles.ca

## Speaking topics
- The Travelpreneur™ Economy
- Travel creator economy and creator monetization
- AI adoption for entrepreneurs
- Tourism and travel technology innovation
- Cross-border and diaspora entrepreneurship
